text: At its meeting on November 1, 2019, the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee considered Item DI6.6, Accessibility in the Underground PATH System.

The General Government and Licensing Committee: 1. Requested the Deputy City Manager, Infrastructure and Development Services, to arrange for a staff presentation to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the first quarter of 2020 regarding accessibility in the underground PATH system, including: a. after-hours PATH system access; and b. an accessibility map.
